title: Appliance Repair Service Request Form
subtitle: Facility Appliance Repair: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Appliance Repair Service Request Form covers commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation. The facility appliance service coordinator records Facility Appliance Repair need, timing, access, and assignment. Appliance Repair Service Request Form keeps Facility Appliance Repair exceptions visible until the facility appliance service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Appliance Repair Service Request Form at shared kitchen, laundry, break area, utility point, and equipment position. Document commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation identity before Facility Appliance Repair begins. Compare commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation findings with stated Facility Appliance Repair criteria; route unresolved Facility Appliance Repair issues to qualified appliance service supervisor. For Appliance Repair Service Request Form, confirm requirements for Facility Appliance Repair. Ask qualified appliance service supervisor to review Facility Appliance Repair conditions beyond the facility appliance service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Requested-service contact and source record
sections.guidance: For Facility Appliance Repair, identify responsible parties, shared kitchen, laundry, break area, utility point, and equipment position, and the linked commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation source.

sections.title: Intake checks and assignment readiness
sections.guidance: Capture Facility Appliance Repair facts for commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Request routing and requester follow-up
sections.guidance: Resolve open Facility Appliance Repair request questions; have facility appliance service coordinator record the assignment, response owner, and requester follow-up while keeping the record strictly at the intake and routing stage.

items: Gas, electrical, refrigerant, water, or combustion hazard
Safe full-cycle test cannot be completed
Prior or requester-supplied: asset label and fault-code image
Prior or requester-supplied: pre-work and repaired-condition photographs
Prior or requester-supplied: part and configuration trace

blocks.guidance: Do not assign or authorize the Facility Appliance Repair request when a utility hazard, protective-device failure, incompatible part, or unsafe operating result remains. Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to facility appliance service coordinator.
